message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

The bug was in the shared `formatMoney` helper in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal list (currently just `JPY`) that prints the amount as-is.

Because the helper is shared, invoice lines (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) will also show yen without decimals now. That is correct if yen amounts are stored as whole yen everywhere. If anything stores yen ×100, tell me and I'll limit the change to receipts instead.
